layout.arrangement: Figure-only slide. White scatter plot with red border centered; yellow badge '48' top-right; three point classes: red outer annulus ring, blue left cluster, black center-right cluster. No title, legend, or equations.

regions.name: plot
regions.content: White plot canvas with red #FF0000 border; y ticks left, x ticks bottom

visual_elements.description: 2D scatter, no legend, no category names; x ticks 0,10,20,30,40; y ticks 0,5,...,35; faint gray gridlines; readable data values are axis ticks only
Red series #FF0000: ~85 points forming a large outer ring/annulus around center ~(25,20), spanning data x~15-35, y~5-31
Blue series #0000FF: ~30 points clustered left, data x~4-16, y~10-22
Black series #000000: ~50 points clustered center-right, data x~22-31, y~11-17

typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout; no title. Axis tick labels ~8-9 pt black; badge '48' bold ~14-16 pt black centered in yellow circle.
